posts.post:
that one friend who insists on wearing a watch everywhere even when they’re just lounging at home.

do you actually need the time, or is it just part of your arm?
the most frustrating part of buying clothes online is guessing how the fabric will actually move once it’s on your body.
true style isn't about the pieces that draw attention. it's about the ones you forget you're even wearing after ten minutes.

we moved the side seam forward by five millimeters on the new prototype today.

it changes how the sleeve falls when your arms are resting down. small, but it changes everything.
